title: Data classification — public
content: Information approved for public release, including published website and approved marketing content.

structured_data.controls: Public access after publishing review; no secrets or personal data.
structured_data.default_retention: Use approved retention_policy by data type
structured_data.export_rule: No export beyond approved purpose and role

title: Data classification — internal
content: Routine internal policies, SOPs, non-sensitive metrics and operational documentation.

structured_data.default_retention: Use approved retention_policy by data type
structured_data.export_rule: No export beyond approved purpose and role

title: Data classification — confidential
content: Customer, supplier, financial, contract, unpublished strategy and detailed system information.

structured_data.controls: Role-scoped access, logging and controlled export.
structured_data.default_retention: Use approved retention_policy by data type
structured_data.export_rule: No export beyond approved purpose and role

title: Data classification — restricted_personal
content: Identity, contact details, KYC, signed evidence, payment references and personal-data requests.

structured_data.controls: Strict purpose limitation, least privilege, encryption and retention controls.
structured_data.default_retention: Use approved retention_policy by data type
structured_data.export_rule: No export beyond approved purpose and role

title: Data classification — restricted_security
content: Secrets, credentials, signing keys, vulnerability details and privileged configuration.

structured_data.controls: Never stored in knowledge corpus or model prompts; accessed only through authorised secret-management paths.
structured_data.default_retention: Use approved retention_policy by data type
structured_data.export_rule: No export beyond approved purpose and role
